Our Story
Four Decades of
Insulation Expertise

Electra Paper & Board Pvt. Ltd. was founded in 1982 as a distributor and stockist for Ballarpur Industries and ITC Ltd. For three decades we imported transformer-grade insulating paper from Japan, China, and Sweden — building unmatched domain knowledge across the entire supply chain.

In 2012 we commissioned our own manufacturing plant at Batouli, Lalru, Mohali. Today we operate with 10,000 MT annual capacity, 250+ direct customers, pan-India supply through our factory and 2 stocking hubs in Delhi NCR, and active export to Nepal.

1982
Entered the electrical insulation industry as distributor & stockist for Ballarpur Industries and ITC Ltd.
1982–2012
Active importer of insulating paper from Japan, China & Sweden — building deep product and market knowledge.
2012
Commissioned own manufacturing plant at Batouli, Lalru, Mohali, Punjab.
Today
10,000 MT capacity · 250+ customers · Pan-India supply · Exporting to Nepal · ₹35 Cr+ FY26 revenue.
